facts.business: Borosil Limited is one of India's leading consumer products companies, offering thoughtfully designed solutions that enhance everyday living through a diversified portfolio spanning cooking, serving, storage, and hydration categories under the Borosil and Larah brands.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus will be on improving furnace capacity utilization through adoption of new technology like XiROC throat main blocks and expanding automation to optimize operational cost.

key_risks: Supply chain dependence and import exposure for certain product categories, exposing the business to supply disruptions, shipping delays, geopolitical developments, and foreign exchange volatility.
